capabilities: Sync Telegram bot messages into the vault as Markdown notes
Download media attachments to configurable file paths
Route messages to folders and templates with filter rules
Fetch new messages by polling or Supabase Realtime
Warn about Supabase storage usage via Telegram
disambiguation: Not a device-to-vault sync tool; it pulls Telegram chat messages into the vault as new notes.
extras: Not yet in the community registry; requires manual installation and self-deploying Supabase Edge Functions, database migrations, and a Telegram bot via BotFather. Telegram Bot API limits file downloads to 20 MB. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture Telegram chat messages and their attachments as notes in the vault.

requires.name: Telegram bot token and Supabase keys

summary: Telegram bridge that pulls bot messages into the vault as Markdown notes through a self-hosted Supabase backend.
